positions.name: MandateToRecordedCommitment
positions.frame: How does a directive's aphoristic authority become a recorded operational commitment?
positions.why: src-1 issues the rollback rehearsal cadence as an aphoristic mandate — an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all — performing the directive's authority through matched-clause urgency. src-3 and src-4 ratify that mandate into the decision record as a settled cadence with a named owner, using the bolded-label-plus-value template that converts the directive into a load-bearing commitment. The directional read spans the conversion from aphoristic principle to recorded fact, holding the tension between the urgency of the maxim and the bureaucratic calm of its recording.
